chunks: And from him, from al-Qāsim, from ʿAlī, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a woman who was found with a man in one garment. He said: “They are to be flogged one hundred lashes, and stoning is not obligatory until the testimony of four is established that they indeed saw him having intercourse with her.”

key_terms.الرَّجْمُ: stoning; a more severe hadd punishment requiring stricter proof
key_terms.الْبَيِّنَةُ الْأَرْبَعَةُ: the fourfold proof; four witnesses whose testimony is required
key_terms.فِي ثَوْبٍ: in one garment; indicating a compromising physical circumstance
key_terms.مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ: one hundred lashes; the number of lashes mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.يُجَامِعُهَا: having intercourse with her; the act that must be directly witnessed
key_terms.يُجْلَدَانِ: they are to be flogged; the prescribed corporal punishment stated here

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman is found with a man in one garment, and when does rajm become obligatory?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man and woman found together in a compromising state. It distinguishes between a punishment established in such a case and the stricter evidentiary requirement for rajm, which is not applied unless four witnesses testify to having seen the act of intercourse.
